name: Weapons of Spirit
summary: Witch Doctor Uzer'i is preparing weapons for you in Feralas. The work takes time, so you wait while the spirits are bound.

sections.title: A Moment's Patience
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i has the materials and the spirits you captured. Imbuing weapons with muisek takes hard work, so Uzer'i asks you to wait while the weapons are prepared.

sections.title: When the Wait Ends
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i returns with weapons for you to choose from. The captured creatures' spirits are sealed inside for good, and you can wield their energy as your own.

faq.q: Who is behind Weapons of Spirit?
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i sent you to gather muisek. This follows Mountain Giant Muisek.

faq.q: What does Witch Doctor Uzer'i do during this step?
aliases: what happens in weapons of spirit
faq.answer: Uzer'i works to bind the captured muisek into weapons. The work is difficult, so Uzer'i asks you to wait while the weapons are prepared.

faq.q: What is needed before Uzer'i can begin?
faq.answer: Uzer'i has the needed materials and the spirits you captured, so the work can begin.

attribution: Classic quest text: Weapons of Spirit
